detail.longDescription: inbuxa's Helm chart has its first release candidate, 27.1.0-rc.1. It runs the mail server, webmail and console on your own PostgreSQL, NATS and S3. Signed, pinned by digest, Pod Security "restricted". Test clusters only for now. Our lab only runs kind, so I'm looking for a few people on k3s, Talos, RKE2 or a cloud to try it and tell me what breaks: https:// community.coffeylabs.org/t/415 # Kubernetes # selfhosted # email # FOSS
